content_of_post_to_comment: I work in a middle school. I always bring my Kindle with me so I have something to read, but lately I've been bringing my physical library books. The kids have noticed! I've been getting lots of questions about what I'm reading, how long the book is, what page I'm on… And a lot of the kids are astounded that I'd voluntarily read a 400+ page book! Most of my students don't read at all, and unfortunately we don't have a school library. It's kinda cool to be a reading role model for them.
